reportId.title: Exposed electrical wiring near water pump

title: Replace and properly insulate exposed wiring in Sector 4
description: Immediately isolate the circuit using LOTO procedure. Replace stripped copper wiring with properly rated IEC 2.5mm² insulated cable. Verify with electrical meter before re-energizing.

reportId.title: Worker observed not wearing harness on elevated platform

title: Immediate fall protection audit and enforcement — Building C Platform
description: Conduct immediate inspection of all elevated platform workers. Issue fall protection harnesses to all workers without. Post mandatory PPE signage. Suspend operations at height until compliance verified.

reportId.title: Wet floor near staircase without warning signs

title: Clean wet floor and install non-slip mat at Block D staircase
description: Clean the water spillage immediately. Install non-slip rubber mat at staircase base. Place wet floor warning signs. Identify source of water leak and fix.
resolutionNotes: Water spillage cleaned. Non-slip mat installed. Warning signs placed. Traced leak to a loose pipe joint — tightened and sealed. Area is now safe.
